style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
title: La torre de bloques
room: Interior of the same bright cozy playroom, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level. Light wooden floor, round pastel-pink rug, big soft building blocks scattered on the rug: green, orange and purple. Big window with soft daylight. The room is empty: no characters, no animals, no faces, no people.
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¡Se cae!
¡Vamos a construir!
[Verse]
Un bloque verde, ¡abajo va!
Un bloque naranja, ¡arriba está!
[Chorus]
Arriba, arriba, ¡más y más!
Mi torre de colores, ¡qué alta está!
[Bridge]
El bloque morado… ¿al revés? ¡No, no!
[Outro]
¡Ya está la torre! ¡Tu-tuuu!
shots: B1
Medium shot: a wobbly tower of big soft blocks tips over in front of the baby elephant, blocks in mid-air, he holds his breath with big eyes.
The block tower wobbles and tumbles, the baby elephant covers his eyes with his ears. Static camera.
B2
Medium shot: the baby elephant stands among scattered green, orange and purple blocks, determined smile, trunk raised.
The elephant raises his trunk and nods, determined to build. Static camera.
B3
Medium close-up: the baby elephant places a big green block on the rug with his trunk.
The elephant sets the green block down carefully with his trunk. Static camera.
B4
Medium shot: the baby elephant puts a big orange block on top of the green block.
The elephant stacks the orange block on top of the green one, it wobbles a little. Static camera.
B5
Wide shot: the baby elephant dances next to a two-block tower, ears flapping, happy.
The elephant dances next to the tower, ears flapping on the beat. Slight camera sway.
B6
Medium shot: the baby elephant holds a purple block upside down above the tower, puzzled face.
The elephant looks at the upside-down purple block and tilts his head, puzzled. Slow push-in.
B7
Medium shot: the baby elephant places the purple block correctly on top of the tower, trunk raised in joy.
The elephant turns the purple block the right way, puts it on top and trumpets happily. Static camera.
B8
Wide shot: the baby elephant proudly next to a tall three-color tower of green, orange and purple blocks.
The elephant smiles proudly, then sneezes with his trunk and the tower wobbles. Static camera.
